class.name: GameplayCueManager
class.brief_description: Finds the handler for a gameplay cue tag.
class.description: Unreal's GameplayCueManager, minus the asset scanning: the handlers are whatever the cue tables name. Loads the tables in [code]application/game_framework/gameplay_cue_tables[/code] on the first cue, and caches every answer. A C++ singleton, not an autoload.

method.name: add_table
method.description: Adds a table at runtime, on top of what the project setting listed; later tables win on a duplicate tag. Clears the cache.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets every table, including the project's - for tests, or a game swapping its whole set of cues.

method.name: find_handler
method.description: The handler for this tag, or its nearest parent that has one; null when none does.
